FRAML
Intelligence Platform
Unified Fraud + AML Detection  ·  Multi-Agent Case Investigation  ·  Regulatory Compliance

FRAML is an autonomous, agentic AI platform with human-in-the-loop (HITL) case investigation, built to address the critical enterprise imperatives created by fraud and AML organizations, processes, and platforms that have historically operated in silos — and the resulting exposure in regulatory reporting and compliance. Historically, financial institutions have operated Fraud mitigation (real-time transaction blocking) and AML compliance (lagging, asynchronous batch reviews) in isolation. This fragmentation in organizations, processes, investigative tools, and data stores creates severe risk blindness, resulting in regulatory Consent Orders, compliance failures, and unpreventable fraud losses (such as charge-offs) due to delayed signal sharing.

Strategic Motivation

Unified Fraud & AML Platform

The design and development of the FRAML Intelligence Platform is driven by three critical enterprise imperatives.

01
Replacing Siloed Legacy Systems — The Operational Silo Problem
Financial institutions have historically run Fraud mitigation (real-time transaction blocking) and AML compliance (lagging, asynchronous batch reviews) as separate functions — separate organizations, processes, tools, and data stores. That fragmentation creates severe risk blindness: regulatory Consent Orders, compliance failures, and unpreventable fraud losses from delayed signal sharing. The platform replaces this disconnected legacy tooling with a single unified system that shares signals, models, and workflows at authorization, targeting directional overhead savings — magnitude to be modeled per deploying institution.
02
Model Trust & AI Defensibility — Responsible & Explainable AI
MAS, FinCEN, and the Federal Reserve, OCC, and FDIC (under SR 26-2 interagency guidance) require automated reasoning in banking to be explainable, transparent, and auditable. The platform eliminates "black-box" models by logging every decision footprint — inputs, prompts, queries, model paths — and enforcing PII redaction outside the LLM gateway. It's voluntarily engineered to SR 26-2 principles ahead of formal enforcement for agentic AI, with human operators retaining 100% final approval authority.
03
Meeting Regulatory Mandates — Enterprise Risk Governance
Regulatory bodies, including the OCC and FinCEN, expect modern financial institutions to manage end-to-end fraud and AML risks globally at the enterprise level, rather than through separate queues. The platform routes alerts into unified joint queues, allowing fraud desks to freeze compromised credentials while compliance desks immediately receive automated Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) drafts.

Capabilities Layers

Five Capability Layers

This capabilities matrix deconstructs the platform into its five core architectural layers. For each layer: the overall goal, the core capabilities that deliver it, and the operational metrics tracked to measure success.

Real-Time Decisioning — live transaction feed, ML risk scoring, and automated case creation at authorization
Multi-Agent Case Investigation — specialist agents synthesizing a Lead Investigator Report
LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluation — GF / TCR / TUA / TE / SE / ATG scoring across investigation runs
Layer 1: AI Control Plane
Merge separate fraud and compliance operations into a single, unified analyst workspace, giving human investigators full visibility and override authority over automated case investigations.
Core CapabilityCapability DescriptionOperational Metric
Interactive ROI DashboardFunctionally aggregates automated triage logs to calculate and display human hours saved, alert triage costs, and the direct losses prevented by blocking sanctions-flagged alerts at authorization.12-Month Product ROI: 50% – 100% ROI, driven by analyst-time and false-positive reduction targets.
Agentic Observability FrameworkFunctionally logs every execution trace and utilizes an LLM-as-a-judge evaluation pattern to rate agent runs against six core dimensions: Groundedness (GF), Task Completion (TCR), Tool Usage Accuracy (TUA), Trajectory Efficiency (TE), System Performance (SE), and Audit Trail Quality (ATG).Agent Performance Score: 100% of cases evaluated using LLM-as-a-judge (tracking GF, TCR, TUA, TE, SE, ATG metrics) to align with SR 26-2 model governance guidelines.
Agentic Workflow Human Persona ReviewerFunctionally intercepts draft narratives and passes them to automated peer critic agents that check formatting, verify evidence links, and review PII redactions prior to human queue release.Case Investigation & Adjudication Time: Target <2.0 mins (representing a 75% – 85% case operational reduction).
Layer 2: Agentic Ecosystem
Orchestrate specialized agent workflows (using LangGraph) and leverage Large and Small Language Models (LLMs/SLMs) as cognitive engines to interpret case context, navigate investigation pathways, and compile regulatory narratives under human supervision.
Core CapabilityCapability DescriptionOperational Metric
Orchestrated Cognitive ReasoningFunctionally coordinates specialized AI agents (Triage, Network, Behavioral) under a central supervisor, using LLMs/SLMs to parse unstructured evidence and write case narratives.Automated Case Triage Rate: Target 80% – 90% of cases auto-triaged post-authorization.
Context & Tokenomics OptimizationFunctionally compresses conversation history, caches repetitive lookups in Redis, and dynamically trims text payloads sent to the models to control execution costs.State Compaction Rate: Target 60% – 70% case data size reduction.
LLM/SLM Tiering & Model SelectionFunctionally matches case complexity to the optimal model tier: lightweight SLMs for high-volume triage, and frontier-scale LLMs reserved for complex narrative drafting.Model Routing Efficiency: 100% of tasks routed via deterministic complexity-based rules.
Prompt Engineering & GovernanceFunctionally decouples system instructions from application code, managing agent prompts as version-controlled text assets to allow instant, auditable behavioral adjustments.Prompt Update Cycle: Zero-downtime hot-reload of model prompts (100% auditable prompt history).
GuardrailsFunctionally validates inputs to block prompt injection and inspects agent-generated outputs to enforce regulatory constraints and automatically redact PII before analyst display.Narrative Compliance Rate: 100% of agent outputs pass through automated guardrail validation before analyst display.
Layer 3: ML Augmentation
Enrich agent decision-making and protect platform integrity by running high-speed statistical models for quantitative risk scoring, and managing the underlying data features and model weighting logic required to execute them.
Core CapabilityCapability DescriptionOperational Metric
Statistical Risk ModelsFunctionally runs open-source ML classifiers (XGBoost/Random Forest) inline at authorization to score incoming transactions in real-time.AI Inference Latency: Target <1.5s average response time per reasoning step.
Feature Engineering & Feature StoreFunctionally calculates and serves dynamic variables (velocity metrics, device sharing frequencies, peer-group deviations) for live model execution.Feature Latency: <5ms feature aggregation latency.
Composite Scoring LogicFunctionally combines independent Fraud and AML model outputs into a single, unified composite score (the FRAML Score) based on pre-set thresholds.False Positive Alert Rate: Target 15% – 25% range (70% – 80% alert noise reduction benchmark).
Layer 4: Data and Knowledge Layer
Maintain hybrid database storage subsurfaces, index compliance libraries, run graph community queries, and preserve logical system schemas.
Core CapabilityCapability DescriptionOperational Metric
Unified Relational & Graph StorageFunctionally synchronizes structured customer profiles in PostgreSQL, fast session caches in Redis, and entity connection maps in Memgraph.Cache Sync Time: <10ms database cache replication sync latency.
Graph Relationship MappingFunctionally maps connections between account holders, devices, and funds routing using graph algorithms to detect coordinated nominee and mule networks.Community Detection Latency: <120ms to search and isolate nominee mule clusters.
Compliance Knowledge Base (RAG)Functionally indexes internal compliance playbooks and runs semantic vector search queries (ChromaDB) to retrieve exact legal guidelines.RAG Retrieval Recall: Target 90%+ accuracy matching case facts to valid regulatory playbooks.
Logical System OntologiesFunctionally aggregates and classifies threat methods, case signals, and model contexts into a single, unified organizational schema that is iteratively refined, improved, and implemented, ensuring every specialist agent, SAR draft, and human investigator uses identical, synchronized definitions.Ontology Verification: 100% of agents and workflows reference a single, shared ontology schema by design, ensuring the schema is iteratively updated and synchronized across all execution runs (eliminating divergent definitions).
Fraud & AML Typology LibraryFunctionally houses a structured registry of 22 active financial crime typologies (comprising 10 AML patterns, 9 Fraud patterns, and 3 cross-discipline FRAML hybrid typologies) that are iteratively classified, improved, and implemented to match case data against pre-defined threat signatures.Typology Match Rate: 100% classification coverage of incoming cases against the 22 mapped threat typologies, ensuring new patterns are iteratively refined and updated in production (target detection latency <120ms).
Layer 5: Integration & Security Layer
Expose secure API endpoints, manage real-time event streaming interfaces, isolate agent query boundaries, and connect the agentic workflow to core banking records and external sanctions databases.
Core CapabilityCapability DescriptionOperational Metric
Ingestion & Core Banking APIsFunctionally exposes high-speed REST endpoints (via FastAPI) that pull customer files, transaction history, and account balances on-demand.Ingestion Throughput: 10,000 transactions per second write and sync capacity.
External Registry ConnectorsFunctionally connects to external watchlists, OFAC SDN lists, PEP registries, and the FinCEN e-filing sandbox.Queue Dispatch Latency: <500ms real-time alert routing latency.
Real-Time Event StreamFunctionally pushes live alert updates and agent tool execution logs to the analyst's screen using WebSocket pipelines.WebSocket Latency: <50ms broadcast delay to connected analyst browser screens.
Isolated Security PerimeterFunctionally isolates the agent execution runtime by enforcing strict read-only database query boundaries and maintaining a hardened gateway that separates the core banking ledger from the AI reasoning engine.Unauthorized Write Attempts: 0 database write permissions granted to automated agents (enforced via database credentials).
